summary_rationale: Costco Wholesale Corporation passes the price-blind business quality gate as a textbook scale-economies-shared compounder. Over FY2017–FY2026, total revenue compounded at 9.96% annually to $303,154M, operating income at 12.31% to $11,685M, and net income at 14.72% to $9,226M while merchandise gross margin stayed disciplined at 11.09% (14%/15% markup cap). Negative working capital ($22,591M accounts payable and $3,006M deferred fees vs. $19,324M inventory) and 94.9% warehouse building ownership drove $15,817M in FY2026 operating cash flow (171.4% of net income), $9,382M free cash flow, 21.23% ROIC, and ~$15.1B net cash ex-leases prior to the November 2026 $30/share (~$13.3B) special dividend. KPI health is PASS_WITH_WATCH: adjusted comp sales (+6.6%), Executive penetration (42.3M members, 75.2% of net sales), and digitally-enabled sales (>$33B, +20.9%) are strong, while U.S./Canada renewal (92.3%) and worldwide renewal (89.8%) sit 60–70 bps below FY2024 peaks due to younger/digital sign-ups, warranting ongoing cohort monitoring alongside Sam's Club Scan & Go competition and locked-in March wage escalators. Audited FY2026 10-K forensics also surface $2,248M current debt maturities, $3,037M accrued member rewards, undiscounted self-insurance reserves, exclusive Citibank co-brand dependence, and IEEPA tariff consumer class-action litigation.
